name: Golden Time
description: Banri Tada is a freshman at a Tokyo law school. After an accident, he suffers severe memory loss. Despite the incident, he befriends fellow freshman, Mitsuo Yanagisawa, which leads him to the beautiful, yet obsessive, Kouko Kaga.

videos.title: Springtime
videos.overview: Banri Tada, a freshman law student at a Tokyo university ended up arriving late for his entrance ceremony.

videos.title: Lonely Girl
videos.overview: Banri has a dream of himself, apparently injured, fleeing from a hospital, but upon awakening cannot remember any more than that.

videos.title: Night Escape
videos.overview: On the day of the scheduled club trip, Banri meets with Kouko and Nijigen, who is also invited.

videos.title: Blackout
videos.overview: After Linda finds them, she explains that she was out on a club retreat with the Festival Club, and brings Banri and Kouko to their campsite.

videos.title: Body and Soul
videos.overview: After finding the photo of him and Linda, Banri runs to the bridge where the accident that caused his amnesia occurred to remember more, but cannot.

videos.title: Yes No
videos.overview: In a dream, Banri remembers that after his love confession to Linda, she agreed to tell him her response the following night on the bridge where Banri would have his accident.

videos.title: Masquerade
videos.overview: Kouko tells Banri that she loves him, but before he can respond Kouko is arrested for stealing a bike that she used to catch up to Banri.

videos.title: Reset
videos.overview: In a flashback, Banri overhears Linda saying she does not see him as a lover, causing him to ignore her for days.

videos.title: With You Again
videos.overview: Kouko suddenly falls ill and does not come to school for several days.

videos.title: In the Mirror
videos.overview: Ghost Banri, having awakened back in his physical body, feels the urge to see Linda.

videos.title: Trouble Party
videos.overview: Banri and Kouko ride the train and discuss Kouko's new Festival Club nickname "RoboGirl," so named because she looks like a robot when she dances.

videos.title: Don't Look Back
videos.overview: Banri Tada is enjoying working as a waiter at the party, along with Nana, Mitsuo and Linda. Meanwhile, Kouko has texted Banri numerous times and is becoming concerned that he hasn't answered.

videos.title: Summer Has Come
videos.overview: As Ghost Banri watches, Banri dreams about when he was in the hospital and met with Linda, and about the message he was supposed to "pass along to her friend."

videos.title: Ladies Talk
videos.overview: 2D calls Banri and tells him that he heard Banri was lonely.

videos.title: Accident Beach
videos.overview: On the day of the trip to the beach, the group encounters several mishaps on the journey.

videos.title: Wake-Up Call
videos.overview: The accident gives Chinami a bloody lip, dents the car's bumper, and damages the guard rail.

videos.title: Return to Yesterday
videos.overview: Banri arrives at the Golden Time restaurant where the Festival Club is setting up for a gathering at the Fireworks Extravaganza and the club members are strangely welcoming and eerily nice, which sets Banri on edge.

videos.title: My Hometown
videos.overview: Kouko enters Banri's apartment alone after going through his mail because she misses him so much.

videos.title: Night in Paris
videos.overview: Banri discusses the event of ghost Banri falling from the bridge with a doctor, who can do nothing more than provide a sedative for him.

videos.title: His Chasm
videos.overview: After Chinami admonishes Banri for being too friendly with Linda because she's the girl Mitsuo likes, Banri catches up with Kouko to share everything that happened.

videos.title: I'll Be Back
videos.overview: After the incident at the Awa dance festival, Banri fears losing himself as his memories from before his accident return.

videos.title: Paradise Lost
videos.overview: Stunned by Kouko's words, Banri waits for her where she had rejected him, hoping she would come back.

videos.title: Resignation
videos.overview: Banri confronts Kouko; she explains the reason why she decided to resign from the Festival Club is due to Banri's unwillingness to be in the same place as her.

videos.title: Golden Time
videos.overview: Upon losing his recent memories, Banri returns to his hometown.
